Polygon copies feature storage and scalar center/count/radius; editor inlines shape assign. Compound clones every child via slot2 then takes ownership. Polygon computes delta from core center then translates center/all feature endpoints and recomputes plane constants without renormalizing edge axes. Compound calls child slot13 plus cached shapes13 and adds stored position; slot12 uses desired minus stored50, then own slot13. Distinct input storage assumed; alias hazards not audited.

broadphase_contract.arguments: Pointers to six-float XYZ min/max; optional third pointer receives bool A-contains-B. It is not an ignore-Z flag.

broadphase_contract.grid_connection: Grid-search Handler query gives both Z limits -binary32(1e38) in assembly. Planar shape slabs include that plane, explaining broadphase membership without treating Z as ignored.

dispatch_contract.limitations: Native predicates are not a universal exact geometric oracle. Ordinary finite normalized inputs reviewed. NaN, negative radius, malformed/empty polygons and degenerate cases lack general correctness guarantees.

distance_contract.segment_point: Clamp t=dot(point-start,unit) to[0,length]; return squared residual. Cached unit/length must be consistent; no normalization at query.
distance_contract.obb_point: Dot point-center with axis/perpendicular; clamp local components to±extents and sum squared residual. Assembly initializes clamp maxima on stack despite uninitialized-looking C locals.
distance_contract.segment_segment: u=dot(A.unit,B.unit),D=B.start-A.start,a=dot(A.unit,D),b=dot(B.unit,D),den=1-u². Ifabs(den)>=epsilon solve/clamp s=(a-b*u)/den to[0,A.length], retaining interior flag; else s0. t=s*u-b. If both solved parameters in range return0. Otherwise clamp t and, when t changed, recompute/clamp s from endpoint projection. Return squared residual. Epsilon approx1e-5. Assembly stores A.length before clamp CMOV despite C missing initialization.
distance_contract.obb_obb: Four separating-axis projections on both boxes unit/perpendicular axes. Reject when absolute center projection exceeds own extent plus projected other extents. No epsilon inflation found here.
distance_contract.obb_capsule: With segment half-length h and center delta D, use box axes and capsule longitudinal/perpendicular axes. Radius expands each projection bound. All four residuals<=0 accepts. No extra nearest-corner axis/distance test. Static example admits separated corner.
distance_contract.box_segment: Four region checks in left,right,top,bottom order. Fully outside both endpoints can select region without604620; crossing configurations consult edge selector. Each branch solves/clamps edge/segment parameters and returns squared residual; no outside region returns0. XMM6 holds box HEIGHT; horizontal top/bottom parameter clamps also use XMM6 although width exists separately inXMM13. Reviewed example rejects real overlap. Treat as native arithmetic rather than general Euclidean distance.
distance_contract.box_edge_selector: Arguments(edgeLength,segmentLength,dNormal,startNormal,dTangent,startTangent,dotStart). Ifabs(dNormal)<epsilon false. t=clamp(-startNormal/dNormal,0,segmentLength),s=clamp(startTangent+t*dTangent,0,edgeLength),q=s*dTangent-dotStart. IfdNormal<=0 returnq<t-epsilon; otherwise returnt+epsilon<q.
distance_contract.obb_polygon: Four corners are written to global game1555E80..9F/editor13BD240..25F, then quad constructor and native polygon distance; temporary vector cleaned. Scratch is not local/TLS. No locking in this body.

polygon_contract.feature_construct: 606D40/479110 storesP,Q,D=Q-P. NormalizeD if squared length>epsilon (~1e-5), else use global initial unit(1,0). Start-plane=(u,-dot(u,P)); end-plane=(-u,dot(u,Q)); side-plane=((u.y,-u.x),-dot(normal,P)). Unit fallback mutable globals146E038/12EC038; no global writer closure claimed.
polygon_contract.quad_construct: 607070/479430 core count4, center=(P0+P1+P2+P3)/4. Test cross(P2-P0,P1-P0)>=0: build edgesP3→P2,P2→P1,P1→P0,P0→P3. OtherwiseP0→P1,P1→P2,P2→P3,P3→P0. It reverses winding using first three points; no observed convexity/duplicate/area validation. Segment constructor count2,center midpoint,featuresP0→P1 andP1→P0.
polygon_contract.point_walk: 607600/4799E0 starts cursor vertex0, next1%N,prev(N-1)%N, budget2N. Vertex compares previous negated end-plane then current negated start-plane, moves to violating edge or accepts vertex. Edge helper607E80 first checks endpoint planes (negative→corresponding vertex). Nonnegative side-distance stops1. Interior side-distance: choose neighboring edge if its absolute side-distance is smaller; otherwise scan all side planes for strictly greatest value (first tie), set that edge, return2 if greatest<0 else0. Nonzero status OR decremented budget<0 stops. Vertex result=Euclidean distance; edge result=signed side-plane evaluation, with projection output. Return floatXMM0, not C integercast.
polygon_contract.pair_walk: 6078E0/479CC0 starts both vertex0 cursors, budget3*(NA+NB). Dispatch typeA*4+typeB:5 vertex/vertex608160,6 vertex/edge608380,9 reversed vertex/edge,10 edge/edge608B20 with reversed cursor arguments. Repeated pair of edge indexes forces one last edge helper then exits regardless of result. Otherwise nonzero helper result OR decremented budget<0 exits. It does not return a separate budget-exhausted error.
polygon_contract.pair_result: Vertex/vertex returns Euclidean distance and vertices. Vertex/edge returns signed edge plane value plus projected point. Edge/edge computes crossing fraction d0/(d0-d1), writes intersection/projection, returns0. No denominator guard in final edge/edge output block. Unsupported feature diagnostics return0. No universal termination-to-correct-distance proof.
polygon_contract.vertex_vertex: 608160 checks B vertex against A previous/current vertex-cone planes, then A vertex against B previous/current; first violation promotes corresponding cursor toedge and returns0. All four nonnegative returns1.
polygon_contract.partial_transition_boundary: 608380/608B20 endpoint-plane tests, clipped segment fractions, side-plane sign/derivative tests and cursor updates reviewed, but complete degenerate/clipping decision table and correctness remain open. Status0 continues; statuses1/2 both terminate callers. Edge helper uses approx1e-5 near-line checks. Do not expose2 as a universal overlap enum: its meaning is branch-specific.
polygon_contract.ownership: Feature-vector copy60F260/481760 allocates/grows or reuses own storage, copies3C-byte rows and sets end.60F4B0 copies center/count/radius (editor clone inlines).617000/489800 is MOVE assignment: frees old destination allocation, steals source begin/end/capacity, zeros source vector pointers, copies center/count but leaves source center/count.6170D0 frees vector and zeros pointers only. compound_contract.append: 617520/489D20 takes raw child pointer without cloning/retaining. First child slots10/9 populate cached circle/box. compound_contract.scratch: Thread-safe initialization guards protect scratch construction only. Geometry scratch contents remain process globals with no observed body-level lock. Full worker serialization, recursive child virtual calls and concurrent access require separate review.
